primary_population: target, resolved scene labels, nonempty complete original slice inventory, all slice predictions successful for both methods and every seed; common intersection
partial_prediction: diagnostic only; observed max >=0.5 is positive lower bound, otherwise unknown if any missing or zero slices
juliet_pairs: all discovered positive-negative scene combinations within same family+flow; unknown entry cardinality and unresolved pair families disclosed separately
mit_pairs: each base min/med/large paired with ok; missing/unknown counts as not simultaneously correct
mit_four_variant: all four variants of each observed official base correct; missing/unknown counts as failure; complete-base count reported
seed_summary: all three observed seeds, arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation; never pool seed-times-scene as independent observations
undefined_metrics: null with explicit reason; never manufacture AUC or CI
source_policy: read accepted immutable tensor cache and scene sidecars only; never external C source
checkpoint_policy: strictly load existing original NoRefiner76 or RiskBridge(AllVisible) states; no training, substitutes or best-seed selection

exact_TRAIN_input_overlap_strata.selection: fixed before model scores; any match in matches[].scene_ids versus no encoded-slice match, within the unchanged all-method/all-seed complete common set
exact_TRAIN_input_overlap_strata.audit: verify exact_input_overlap.json selfhash and its preparation receipt identity; bind audit hash to statistics request
exact_TRAIN_input_overlap_strata.primary_unchanged: retain primary population, all target counts, every identifiable pair and MIT four-variant denominator
exact_TRAIN_input_overlap_strata.report: both strata six metrics per seed, observed three-seed mean and sample SD; descriptive secondary strata without CI; no-input scenes never classified as clean
exact_TRAIN_input_overlap_strata.scope: exact original encoded input equality only, not proof of raw-source or semantic independence
